title: Fix SSE keepalive handling and ensure DONE terminates stream
author: Ethan Park
description: Context: Support escalations show Python streaming chat can hang when we receive SSE keepalive comment frames and the proxy coalesces lines. Our iterator ignored comment frames but also failed to detect the terminal [DONE] when it arrived without a trailing newline. Changes: (1) tolerate ':' keepalive comments, (2) robustly parse event boundaries, (3) treat [DONE] as terminal even if line ending is missing, (4) add a configurable stream_read_timeout with a clear error message. Includes regression tests using recorded payloads from SUP-4821.
commits: sdk/python: parse DONE without trailing newline
tests: add keepalive + coalesced frame fixture
review_conversation: Reviewer (Maya): Please add a test for a blank line between events.
Reviewer (Avery): Can we default the read timeout to None to avoid behavior changes?
Author (Ethan): Kept default None; only surfaced option and improved parsing.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash; released in redwood-sdk-python 1.8.3
